items: No native corrupt-FCS generator: direct corrupted FCS ingress rejection is not a CLI fixture.
No explicit source MAC override: MAC move/static-shadow unit tests use production planner directly; cannot spoof two native endpoint source MACs here.

Fresh staged unit tests cover admission, SOF arithmetic overflow, Effects validation and publication reservation failures. Not every specified codec/control/arrival/tree/drop allocation point has an independently injected CLI failure.
Fractional credit/token, u128 saturation and generation-overflow tests are production planner unit execution, not CLI fault hooks.
Production Viewer/browser, old-profile whole-suite regressions and cross-profile >2^53 rendering are parent-owned; this report does not claim their execution.
No IEEE, BPDU, IGMP, MLD or MVRP protocol conformance claim.
1000 same-key refreshes bound pending events to1; not a large-scale performance claim.
